map.最佳正畸力多大？: How large is the optimal orthodontic force?
map.因移动类型而异：整体移动约 50~100g/牙，控根更小，扩弓与颌间牵引各有范围: Varies by movement type: whole-tooth about 50-100g/tooth, root control less, expansion and intermaxillary traction each have ranges; light and continuous force is best.
map.力太大有什么危害？: What are the dangers of too much force?
map.过大压力致牙周膜透明样变、牙根吸收甚至坏死，移动反而变慢；应遵正畸医师加力方案。: Excessive pressure causes periodontal hyalinization, root resorption even necrosis, and movement actually slows; follow the orthodontist's force plan.
map.能自己调力吗？: Can I adjust the force myself?
map.不能。正畸力值由医师根据托槽/弓丝系统设计，擅自调力会损及牙根与牙周；异常疼痛及: No. Orthodontic force is set by the dentist from the bracket/wire system; adjusting it yourself damages root and periodontium; for abnormal pain, return promptly.
